maddeler.e:
اغتنيت (form VIII)
# اِغْتَنَيْتُ (iḡtanaytu) /iɣ.ta.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِغْتَنَى (iḡtanā)
# اِغْتَنَيْتَ (iḡtanayta) /iɣ.ta.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِغْتَنَى (iḡtanā)
# اِغْتَنَيْتِ (iḡtanayti) /iɣ.ta.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْتَنَى (iḡtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
